about: The one sentence about each company in outreach@web-summit.silvio's 28 drafts (in Silvio's mailbox, not sent), with where each fact came from and when it was read, as Dinis's inbox agent asked on 5 November 2026. 'channel' says whether the company publishes an address on its own site (checked 5 November), has only a web form, or neither. No address or person's contact is kept here.

drafts.name: AICEP - Portugal Trade & Invest
drafts.sentence: A AICEP ajuda as empresas portuguesas a expandir-se para fora, com escritórios em cerca de 50 países.

drafts.name: Startup Portugal
drafts.sentence: A Startup Portugal e a Web Summit selecionam até 125 startups portuguesas para a edição deste ano, no Road 2 Web Summit.

drafts.name: ChatPlace
drafts.sentence: O gestor de IA da ChatPlace responde a mensagens e comentários 24 horas por dia em nome dos criadores.

drafts.name: KPMG
drafts.sentence: A KPMG é parceira da Web Summit, e a final global do KPMG Private Enterprise Global Tech Innovator é em Lisboa durante o evento.

drafts.name: Feedzai
drafts.sentence: Feedzai's CTO is speaking at Web Summit on "Who let the agent in?".

drafts.name: Cisco (Outshift by Cisco)
drafts.sentence: Cisco brings Outshift and DevNet to Web Summit, with open-source projects for agentic AI.

drafts.name: Hexamind
drafts.sentence: Hexamind publishes Hexgate, an open-source layer that checks every tool call an AI agent makes against a policy. (Attendance unconfirmed: the email says 'If you're at Web Summit'.)

drafts.name: Primitive
drafts.sentence: Primitive gives AI agents their own email address.

drafts.name: Mastra
drafts.sentence: Mastra is an open-source TypeScript framework for building production agents.

drafts.name: Qase
drafts.sentence: Qase is launching Tiden, which records what was asked and checks every change a coding agent makes against it.

drafts.name: Replit
drafts.sentence: Replit lets anyone build applications in natural language, and has more than 500,000 business users.

drafts.name: 1Password
drafts.sentence: 1Password is building a security layer for how AI agents authenticate and connect.

drafts.name: Cloudflare
drafts.sentence: Cloudflare's homepage now leads with "Build for the agent era".

drafts.name: Delinea
drafts.sentence: Delinea governs what people, machines and AI agents do once they have access, with just-in-time authorisation.

drafts.name: Polygraf AI
drafts.sentence: Polygraf's AI Behavioral Control Plane enforces governance across human and agent interactions in real time.

drafts.name: Descope
drafts.sentence: Descope gives AI agents and MCP servers scoped access, and is running a session at Web Summit on securing AI agents.

drafts.name: Airia
drafts.sentence: Airia gives enterprises one control layer for agents, models, tools and data, with runtime policy and audit evidence.

drafts.name: Emergence
drafts.sentence: Emergence's co-founder is speaking at Web Summit on "When AI agents go rogue".

drafts.name: Linux Foundation (Agentic AI Foundation)
drafts.sentence: The Agentic AI Foundation, at the Linux Foundation, is a neutral home for open standards in agentic AI, and its Executive Director is speaking at Web Summit.

drafts.name: Conscium
drafts.sentence: Conscium tests and verifies AI agents in simulation before they are deployed.

drafts.name: Scrut Automation
drafts.sentence: Scrut runs AI agents to collect compliance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and more than 60 frameworks.

drafts.name: Cnext
drafts.sentence: Cnext builds secure, compliant agents for European businesses on its Kairos platform.

drafts.name: Risiq GmbH
drafts.sentence: Risiq helps banks meet regulatory requirements and build risk management, with its Ribeca platform.

drafts.name: Melious AI GmbH
drafts.sentence: Melious serves open-weight models from European infrastructure, through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.

drafts.name: Firefox Enterprise by Mozilla
drafts.sentence: Firefox Enterprise gives European organisations a browser platform they control.

drafts.name: SpaceComputer
drafts.sentence: SpaceComputer builds confidential computing, key management and attestation for cloud and AI workloads.

drafts.name: Trent AI
drafts.sentence: Trent AI works like an AI security engineer, finding the real risk in code, cloud and AI agents and verifying every fix.

drafts.name: TrustScale
drafts.sentence: TrustScale's CEO is speaking at Web Summit on "Whose AI is it anyway?", and its platform measures AI against each customer's own criteria.
